name: precip_rain_motion
_comment: T-I5a-DR-storm-motion-v2: MOTION-CLIP rain. A separate emitter used ONLY for the LUMINUMBRA_ATMOS_MOTION_CAPTURE clip so the gate-blessed precip_rain.json (which the Precipitation/WeatherVisual gates assert against) stays byte-identical. Tuned for SMOOTH, TRACKABLE FALL in the 0.045s-interval motion capture: LONGER streaks (so consecutive captured frames overlap and the same streak is visibly the same streak moved down) at a believable fall speed (each captured frame a streak descends ~40-50% of its own length, reading as continuous downward streaming rather than re-randomised shimmer). Density and colour match the storm look.
